items.name: Product traceability regulations
items.version: Varies by industry and jurisdiction (e.g. food safety, medical device, automotive)
items.jurisdiction: Industry- and jurisdiction-specific (e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 820 for US medical devices, EU Regulation 2017/745 MDR)
items.scope: Requiring forward/backward genealogy of lots and serials from raw material to finished, shippable product, often with defined retention periods.
items.notes: Neither cloned source implements a regulation-specific retention or reporting requirement; both provide the underlying genealogy data (InvenTree StockItemTracking, Odoo stock.lot) that a compliant process would be built on top of. Applicability depends entirely on the product being manufactured.

provenance.notes: Flagged from the domain brief's guidance on traceability; not verified against a specific regulation's text.

items.name: ISO 9001 quality management
items.jurisdiction: Global (voluntary, contractually required by some customers)
items.scope: Documented quality management processes, including inspection records, non-conformance handling, and corrective action.
items.notes: A voluntary certification, not a legal requirement; named here because inspection/non-conformance record-keeping is commonly built to support it, not because either cloned source implements or claims certification.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from InvenTree's test-template/test-result model, which is the kind of record ISO 9001 audits typically require; not a claim of certification support.
